audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Gwen "he/his" in tldr, winCon, both phases text and every trade line, and Level 3, First item and 2+ items are marked Gwen while carrying Akshan-favoured boilerplate.
audit.why: Gwen is female. The stage sides themselves are right and match the Gwen-side mirror exactly — the lane is yours at 1, 2 and 6, hers at 3, 4-5 and both item stages — but the stage text never argued for its own side.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and the three contradicted stages now name the mechanic: Hallowed Mist plus Skip 'n Slash at 3, A Thousand Cuts healing through Youmuu's at first item, and Riftmaker/Nashor's at two.

audit.why: The four spikes match both kits: Akshan at 2-3 before Hallowed Mist exists, Akshan at Youmuu's, the contested level 6 between Comeuppance (100/85/70) and Needlework (120/100/80), and Gwen at Riftmaker plus Nashor's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is described as making Gwen flatly "untargetable" in five strings, with advice to back off entirely until it drops. Its cooldown is never given anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's description is narrower and it matters: "She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist." Gwen is not untargetable — she is protected from enemies OUTSIDE the mist. Stepping into the mist keeps her targetable and keeps a Comeuppance lock alive, which is a real option the page told you not to consider. And at 22/21/20/19/18s the mist has genuine downtime worth counting rather than treating as permanent.
audit.corrected: Every instance now states the from-outside-only rule and offers stepping in as the alternative to waiting, with the 22s rank-1 cooldown given in the cooldown block, the do's, the interactions report and the early text.

edits.before: Level 1 is a wash — you only have one passive shot and a Q boomerang and she just wants to last-hit, so trade nothing and set up your level-2 spike. Once you get the second passive shot at 2 and Heroic Swing at 3, this is your lane: she is melee with no ranged answer to your boomerang, and her W Hallowed Mist has a cooldown, so poke her every time the mist is down. Don't dive in while mist is up — outside it she's untargetable and your Q, double-shot and even your R lock-on do nothing, so back off and re-poke when it drops.
edits.after: Level 1 is a wash — you only have one passive shot and a Q boomerang and she just wants to last-hit, so trade nothing and set up your level-2 spike. Once you get the second passive shot at 2 and Heroic Swing at 3, this is your lane: she is melee with no ranged answer to your boomerang, and Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1, so poke her every time it is down. While the mist is up nothing you throw from outside it lands — but she is only protected from enemies outside the mist, so stepping in keeps her targetable when the trade is worth melee range.

edits.before: This is all Gwen. Once she finishes Riftmaker and Nashor's, her Q snips do true damage you cannot itemize against, her W keeps her untargetable through your whole burst and R lock-on, and her E-dash closes the gap faster than your camo can run. Your lethality kit falls off a cliff into her — you can't execute a target who heals through omnivamp and hides in mist. Win this lane before two items: snowball your early-to-mid lead, take her tower or her flash, and group to end while your power still means something, because the long game belongs to her.
edits.after: This is all Gwen. Once she finishes Riftmaker and Nashor's, her Q snips do true damage you cannot itemize against, Hallowed Mist blanks your whole burst and R lock-on from outside it, and her E-dash closes faster than your camo can run. A Thousand Cuts heals her off every auto, so buy anti-heal or stop trying. You can't execute a target who heals through the burst and stands where you can't shoot. Win this before two items: snowball the early lead, take her tower or her flash, and group to end while your power still means something.

notes: The Gwen-side mirror's win array is identical to this one, so no chart change was needed in either direction. The one thing worth someone confirming is whether Comeuppance's lock-on actually survives Hallowed Mist when Akshan is standing inside the mist — Riot's text supports it (she is targetable by enemies inside), but the interaction between an in-progress channel and the mist boundary is not in the data, so the pages now say 'step in to keep the lock' rather than promising it holds through a boundary crossing.
